title: R-30 Inspection ROV
description: A tethered inspection ROV for visual assessment of submerged structures, with payload and sensor selection matched to the task.

title: R-45 Inspection ROV
description: A tethered inspection platform with a higher brochure payload than the R-30, for projects needing additional sensing or tooling.

title: AD-400 Tunnel inspection ROV
description: A specialist platform for long-distance inspection of flooded water tunnels, combining a tethered vehicle with project-specific sensing and tether management.

title: A-80 Underwater cleaning robot
description: A floating and crawling underwater platform described by the manufacturer for contact cleaning, with cavitation water-jet and brush configurations subject to application review.

title: AD-100 Underwater dredging robot
description: A remotely operated platform described in the manufacturer brochure for underwater sump dredging, with suction, conveyance and treatment selected together.

title: R-20 / R-20Li Portable inspection ROV
description: A compact 16 kg observation ROV with a tethered power supply (R-20) or an internal lithium battery (R-20Li), for fast visual checks where vehicle size and handling matter.

title: R-150 Light work-class ROV
description: A 195 kg light work-class ROV rated to 500 m, with a 20 kg payload and modular interfaces for sensors and tools on offshore and hydraulic-structure tasks.

title: A-400 Crawler inspection robot
description: A 400 kg tracked underwater robot that switches between swimming and crawling on submerged structures, for dam, intake and hydropower inspection to 300 m.
